title: fix(platform-objects): the rest of the report panel hints read the business wording in ja-JP, es-ES and zh-CN
body:
Fixes #37384

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用日文、西班牙文（以及部分中文）搭报表的人，在报表设置面板里看到的"列分组、排序、分块、图表、日期范围、导出选项"六条说明和"联合分块""筛选与图表"两段分区说明，现在和英文说的是同一件事，不再是旧的"维度 / 度量 / 数据集"开发者说法。
- 属于报表面板改用业务用语的收尾，接上一轮只修了六行和四个标签的那张卡，补齐其余译文。
- 出错只会是某条译文措辞不够好，不影响任何功能或数据，随时可以直接改回或再改。
- 无。

## What changes

Translation text only, in the three hand-written locale bundles of `@objectstack/platform-objects` (`zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES` `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`), `report` block. No key added or dropped; `pnpm check:i18n` is in sync. Vocabulary follows PR #37377: データソース / 指標 / グループ化 · Fuente de datos / Métricas / Agrupar por · 数据来源 / 指标 / 分组. The enum tokens `matrix` / `joined` stay as tokens, as the English and each bundle's own `type` hint keep them.

**Every leaf re-translated** (current English, then the new value per locale):

| Leaf | English | ja-JP | es-ES | zh-CN |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `report.sections.joined_blocks.description` | Other blocks stacked into the same report, each with its own data source (joined reports only). | 同じレポートに積み重ねる他のブロック。それぞれ独自のデータソースを持ちます（joined レポートのみ）。 | Otros bloques apilados en el mismo informe, cada uno con su propia fuente de datos (solo informes joined). | 叠加进同一张报表的其他分块，各有自己的数据来源（仅 joined 报表） |
| `report.sections.filter_and_chart.description` | Filter conditions and how the chart is shown. | フィルター条件と、チャートの表示方法。 | Las condiciones de filtro y cómo se muestra el gráfico. | unchanged (条件与图表展示 already follows) |
| `report.fields.columns.helpText` | Groups spread across the columns (matrix reports only). | 列方向に展開するグループ（matrix レポートのみ）。 | Grupos distribuidos en las columnas (solo informes matrix). | 横向展开的分组（仅 matrix 报表） |
| `report.fields.order.helpText` | What to sort by, most important first (a grouping or a metric). Time groupings sort in date order by default. | 並べ替えの基準。重要なものから順に指定します（グループまたは指標）。時間のグループは既定で日付順に並びます。 | Por qué ordenar, lo más importante primero (una agrupación o una métrica). Las agrupaciones de tiempo se ordenan por fecha de forma predeterminada. | 排序依据，最重要的在前（某个分组或指标）。时间分组默认按时间先后排列。 |
| `report.fields.blocks.helpText` | Sub-reports, each with its own data source (joined reports only). | サブレポート。それぞれ独自のデータソースを持ちます（joined レポートのみ）。 | Subinformes, cada uno con su propia fuente de datos (solo informes joined). | 子报表，各有自己的数据来源（仅 joined 报表） |
| `report.fields.chart.helpText` | Chart type and settings. | チャートの種類と設定。 | Tipo y configuración del gráfico. | unchanged (图表类型与配置 already follows) |
| `report.fields.dateRange.helpText` | The period the report opens with, and whether people may choose their own range. | レポートを開いたときに表示される期間と、利用者が自分で範囲を選べるかどうか。 | El período con el que se abre el informe y si cada persona puede elegir su propio rango. | 打开报表时显示的时间段，以及使用者能否自己选择范围 |
| `report.fields.exportOptions.helpText` | Download formats (csv, xlsx) and file name. Who may download is set by the export permission on the data source’s object. | …データソースのオブジェクトのエクスポート権限で決まります。 (データセット → データソース) | …el permiso de exportación del objeto de la fuente de datos. (del conjunto de datos → de la fuente de datos) | …由数据来源对象上的导出权限决定 (数据集 → 数据来源) |

Counts: ja-JP 8 leaves, es-ES 8 leaves, zh-CN 6 leaves. zh-CN `filter_and_chart.description` and `chart.helpText` were already current against the English and are left as is. The six zh-CN values that moved match the console's own zh overlay (`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`), which already carried the current English, except that the platform bundle keeps the `matrix` / `joined` tokens its `type` hint and `joined_blocks` label use, where the overlay writes 矩阵表 / 联合报表.

**Ledger.** `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`: the `values.helpText` row's reason cited its sibling `order.helpText` as naming the rows/columns dimension and values measure vocabularies; that sibling no longer does, so the reason gains one sentence saying so and keeps the precedent as the record of why the leaf was reached. No verdict or pinned value moved: no ledger pins any of the leaves above by value (they are the population's authored, non-echoing negatives).

## Acceptance notes

- **Card item "the PR names every leaf it re-translated"**: the table above names all 22 locale-leaves; the two zh-CN leaves left as is are named too.
- **Same-family leftovers, not in this card** (noted, not filed): `report.fields.type.helpText` still reads the enum list as slash-joined tokens (tabular / summary / matrix / joined) in all three bundles while the English reads "Report type: tabular, summary, matrix or joined."; the meaning matches, so it is not stale. `report.sections.joined_blocks.label` in zh-CN reads `joined 报表分块` where the console overlay reads 联合报表的分块; label leaves were outside this card.
- `dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` cites `report.sections.joined_blocks.label is 关联对象` in one reason, which the bundle no longer reads; that row is the dataset panel's and its verdict does not depend on it. Not touched.

## Verification

First read, by risk:
1. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/ja-JP.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, `report` block: the 8 changed values.
2. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/es-ES.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, `report` block: the 8 changed values.
3. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, `report` block: the 6 changed values.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/apps/translations`, expect 26 files, 610 tests passed. In the browser: switch Studio to 日本語, open any report, and the Sort Order hint reads 並べ替えの基準。重要なものから順に指定します（グループまたは指標）… with no rows / columns / values tokens.
